documentation: The universe of Lean repositories meeting the inclusion criteria, pulled from the GitHub API. Generated on 2026-09-03T10:32:14.150510. Includes every public repository with a root lake-manifest.json and an OSI-approved license, with its stars and last activity as data rather than as filters: the crawl recomputes eligibility from those each run, so this is not a pre-filtered active list. Replaces the reservoir index while https://github.com/leanprover/reservoir/issues/109 is open.
